name: REARGUARD ACTION
situation_report: The main force is withdrawing and your rearguard must buy them time. Enemy forces are pursuing aggressively. Your mission: establish successive delay positions, inflict casualties, slow the pursuit, and extract your forces intact. Every hour of delay is a success.
tactical_context: This is one of the most difficult missions: fighting while retreating. The rearguard must trade space for time without being decisively engaged. Position, delay, inflict casualties, disengage, fall back, repeat. The pursuer must press hard before the rearguard can organize the next position.

terrain_features.name: Paved Road
terrain_features.special_rules: Fast movement for vehicles. Key strategic route. Often an objective.

terrain_features.name: Fortified Position
terrain_features.description: Prepared defensive position with trenches and dugouts.
terrain_features.special_rules: Infantry gain hard cover with +1 to cover saves. Difficult terrain for vehicles.

terrain_features.name: Escarpment
terrain_features.description: Steep cliff face or escarpment. Major tactical feature.
terrain_features.special_rules: Impassable to vehicles. Infantry can climb (dangerous terrain). Artillery observers gain +1.

terrain_features.name: Wadi (Dry)
terrain_features.description: Dry riverbed cutting through desert. Excellent cover and concealment.
terrain_features.special_rules: Infantry and vehicles in wadi gain hard cover. Counts as difficult terrain to enter/exit.

terrain_notes: Mix of terrain providing successive defensive positions

effects: Desert Dust Cloud begins on turn 2
From turn 2: Maximum artillery spotter range 40"

victory_conditions:
**Defender Major Victory**: Exit 75%+ of force off North edge by turn 8.

**Defender Minor Victory**: Exit 50-74% of force off North edge.

**Attacker Victory**: Prevent defender escape (defender exits <50%).

**Draw**: Defender escapes but suffers 50%+ casualties.
deployment_steps: Defender places 3 successive delay positions (South, Center, North)
Defender deploys 1/3 force at each position
Defender may withdraw units that break contact (move to next position)
Game has 8 turn limit - defender wins by surviving

special_rules: Can withdraw units that break contact
Victory = time delay, not holding ground
**Fighting Withdrawal**: Defender may withdraw units to next position if not in contact
**Successive Positions**: Defender has 3 prepared positions to fall back through
**Time Limit**: 8 turns - defender wins by exiting units off North edge
**Exit Points**: Defender scores points for units exited off North edge
**Pursuit**: Attacker must press hard to prevent organized withdrawal
**Prepared Positions**: Each defender position starts with defensive prep
